note: Reachable findings the gate (scripts/govulncheck.mjs) does not count, each with its evidence. A record excuses a finding only when the module directory, the vulnerable module AT THIS VERSION and the id all match, govulncheck names no fixed version, and every frame it reports is a package init (the package is linked in; no function of it is called). A call into the module, a new version, a new id or a fix turns the gate red again, and a record the run no longer reports fails the gate, so this list cannot go stale.

accepted.reason: Eight advisories on the Ollama server (introduced 0, no fixed version, v0.40.15 is still affected). The adapter does not use Ollama: kagent's own packages do. cmd/kagent-pig calls kagent's adk/pkg/app.New, which imports adk/pkg/a2a, whose executor imports adk/pkg/models, which imports github.com/ollama/ollama/api for kagent's Ollama model client. The advisories name no symbol, so govulncheck reports the init of the linked packages (api, auth, envconfig, format, model, orderedmap, version) and nothing else; the adapter starts no Ollama server and serves no Ollama endpoint. kagent main (4de694355985) imports the same module at the same version, so a kagent bump does not remove it. kagent's own Claude Code and Codex harnesses (go/harness/claude/cmd/main.go, go/harness/codex/cmd/main.go at kagent main) import the same adk/pkg/app, so they link the same Ollama packages, and OSV lists no fixed version for any of the eight.
